title: 日本ダービーの後に・慙愧

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wasn't able to take first place. She regrets spending the race distracted by her shoes, even though there was nothing wrong with them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In her mind, that shows that she let the jinx get the better of her, which she can't forgive herself for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to hone her skills and overcome her jinx by winning the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We stop be a cafe on our way back, where we hear overhear a passionate conversation. It seems that Kitasan Black's fans relate to her perseverance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling as though Kitasan Black is leaving her behind, Satono Diamond thinks she needs to become worthy of being her rival.
